title: Media folders
lead: The folders inside this app where it may read your library's files, such as /media inside its container. Files outside them, or reached through a link that leads out of them, are never read.
listDescription: Give each folder's path as the app sees it. Saving doesn't look at the files: on the Library page, use Scan folders to find the files no library reported and Inspect files to read them all, or wait for the next sync.
empty: No folder yet: the app reads no file until you add one.
saveFailed: Could not save the media folders.
loadFailed: Could not load the media folders.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded folders.
